title: Super Simple Wynn
description: A simple modpack for the server Wynncraft.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d8f9ce8fe6030ff94ab4fa9db7271fc9f8eb1c7.webp)

Are all you see bloat filled modpacks with sketchy download locations? This is a simple modpack for the minecraft server Wynncraft. It includes the bare minimum of performance mods and 3 highly reccomended Wynncraft specific mods such as:

- Wynntils
- WynnAspects
- Wynnventory
- Wynncraft Spell Caster

Play Wynncraft at: https://wynncraft.com/



Disclaimer: This modpack is not official nor does it directly associate with Wynncraft. This is community made.
